text:
Oliver: hi all 30 day 1 hiccup. 1Password invite showed up but the link errors with "link expired". also trying to enroll passkey on my Windows 11 machine (Edge) and it says "Authenticator not supported". phone push for Okta never arrived either. anyone run into this combo?
Maya (IT): welcome! can you confirm which email you used to accept invites? sometimes corporate aliases vs personal inboxes cause expired links. also for Edge/Windows Hello, make sure Edge is up-to-date and Windows Hello setup is complete in Settings > Accounts > Sign-in options.
Oliver: i used oliver.temp+signup@gmail.com (doh). Edge is 108.0.1462 (not latest). phone is iPhone 13 iOS 16.4.1.
Priya (onboarding): quick FYI we saw a small outbound mail delay this morning due to a DMARC heuristic on the team console provider; IT can reissue invites manually. i'll note it on the checklist.
Sam (eng-infra): for Edge, NotSupported usually means either the browser is too old or the RP (origin) doesn't match. Try clearing site data for the org URL and re-try in latest Chrome if you can. For Okta push, check the Okta Verify app under Devices 30 sometimes the push queue stalls if multiple enroll attempts were made.
Maya (IT): resending 1Password invite to your canonical work email now and mapping the personal alias. also toggled the org WebAuthn setting to force a re-sync. Give it a minute.
onboarding-bot: 1Password invite resent to oliver@redwood.ai at 1902000032.
Oliver: invite arrived to work email and accepted. thanks! tried passkey enroll again in Edge after updating to 118 and it still failed with "Authenticator not supported". switched to Chrome and enrollment worked (registered as "oliver-windows-hello").
Sam (eng-infra): Chrome fallback makes sense. Edge has different WebAuthn behaviour on older Windows builds. glad Chrome worked. About the Okta push: i see a pending push for the personal alias which didn't map to the org account. @Maya, can you force a device sync?
Maya (IT): forced a directory sync and cleared the stale push transaction. Oliver, i triggered a new Okta push to your iPhone; check Okta Verify and accept. also we stored your emergency recovery codes into 1Password after you accepted.
Oliver: got the Okta push and accepted. recovery codes are in 1Password, nice. question: will the yubikey (i also have one) work with Windows Hello or should i keep using a passkey?
Sam (eng-infra): YubiKey works as a roaming authenticator (FIDO2) on Windows too; if you prefer a hardware key, enroll it as a second factor in Okta after passkey is set. we recommend having both a passkey and a hardware key as backup.
Priya (onboarding): adding a note: if you accepted invites on a personal email, ping IT immediately so we can map aliases and re-run app provisioning. also note to prefer Chrome for first-time passkey enroll on Windows if Edge misbehaves. i'll update the onboarding doc. :memo:
Oliver: all set now 30 1Password, Okta push, recovery codes, passkey. yubikey left as follow-up. thanks everyone!
Maya (IT): resolving this thread. ping if you want us to register your SSH pubkey or help enroll yubikey. :white_check_mark:
